caption_L1: Here a bar plot is named Forecast volume of high fructose corn syrup consumed in the European Union (EU 27) from 2016 to 2029 (in 1,000 tonnes). The x-axis measures Volume in thousand tonnes while the y-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: After a decline in consumption over the years 2016-2019, high fructose corn syrup consumption will continue to rise every year through to 2029. Starting with a volume low of around 550 thousand tonnes in 2017, it will rise to over 900 thousand tons consumed per year by 2029.
